claim: For events from Salesforce, Amazon AppFlow currently uses a third-party library, which is allocated a fixed buffer size of 10 MB. If a surge of events on a single event channel exceeds the buffer size, events might be dropped; you can request a larger buffer by filing a support case.

qualifiers.scope: events from Salesforce (the third-party library buffer)
qualifiers.condition: A larger buffer is requested by filing a support case in the AWS Management Console.
